subject: Sales/Finance/Infra: Weekly fleet-capacity bridge call
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.nguyen@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-04-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly bridge: pipeline -> capacity

Team / Sara,

Kicking off this week’s bridge between Sales, Finance and Infra to convert pipeline forecasts into dedicated GPU sizing for Q3. Goal: produce a single row-per-deal ask by next Friday that infra can ingest into provisioning and finance can translate to commit/POs.

Quick context: several pilots (Acme, Everest) are lining up for July–Aug and we need to align on whether we expect reserved capacity vs. burstable hosted. Infra has limited A100 availability in us-west for that window.

Ask before today’s call at 9:00 PT:
- Sales: populate the attached template with expected start date, peak concurrent sessions, and preferred commit (yes/no).
- Finance (Grace): flag deals where procurement already committed to PO/term.
- Infra (Vivek/Karthik): confirm headroom by week and what SKU mix you can commit to for Q3.

Attachment: pipeline_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Agenda for the 9:00 call: 1) Quick top-5 deals review, 2) mapping to GPU SKUs and rental model, 3) action items for PO/commit timeline.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: pipeline -> capacity

Jordan — thanks for kicking this off. High-level notes before the call:

- Top deals to prioritize: Acme Corp (pilot -> GA in July), Everest Analytics (PO in negotiation, likely Aug), and Meridian Health (proof-of-concept only). I’m attaching a short summary of committed dollars and our best-guess ARR if pilot converts.
- Sales guidance: unless the customer explicitly asks for reserved capacity, default to dedicated-slab offers for pilots >50 concurrent sessions — we want predictable latency for their demos.
- Ask to Finance (Grace): please flag any deals with CFO-level approval already in writing — those can go to infra for reservation.

Attachment: Q2_commit_summary.pdf (summary)

Onwards in 15.
Laura
Director, Enterprise Sales

> Team / Sara,
> 
> Kicking off this week’s bridge...
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: pipeline -> capacity

Thanks — quick infra readout to bring into the call: 

Current headroom (us-west) for July window:
- A100-p4d equivalent: 18 reserved slots available for Q3 (we can shard across tenants but latency SLOs tighten).
- H100 pool: limited, generally reserved for internal evals; we can offer 6 ephemeral slots.
- Cost delta: reserved A100 ~ 35% cheaper than burst/spare on-demand.

Operational notes / constraints:
- If Sales expects >200 concurrent sessions sustained over a week, we should convert to a reserved pool; otherwise burst is acceptable for small pilots.
- We need explicit PO or signed commit to hold slots beyond 30 days.
- Migration/quantization options are available for some model families which can reduce GPU footprint by ~30% — we should earmark candidate deals for optimization.

I’ve attached a one-page snapshot with the SKU mix and calendarized availability. Let me know which deals in the template are firm and I’ll mark capacity holds for them (pending finance confirmation).

Attachment: gpu_headroom_snapshot.csv (csv)

Vivek
Head of Infra Operations

On 2027-04-11 08:45, Laura Bennett wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for kicking this off. High-level notes before the call:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acmecorp.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: pipeline -> capacity

Jordan / Laura,

Quick reply from Acme ops: pilot target = week of July 11th. Expected peak concurrency for the pilot is ~120 sessions (each session ~2 requests/sec for 30s). If we move to GA we expect ~800 concurrent sustained in month 2. Procurement is aiming to have a PO to you by May 20th — I’ll confirm once legal finishes the SOW redlines.

We prefer reserved capacity for GA; pilot can run on burst if reserved slots are not available immediately. Happy to join the call to confirm load profile.

Sara Nguyen
Head of Cloud Ops, Acme Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: sara.nguyen@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: pipeline -> capacity — action items

Thanks everyone — short action list from this morning’s sync:

1) Sales (Laura/Jordan): update pipeline_template.xlsx rows for Acme & Everest with the dates and expected peak concurrencies by EOD Friday.
2) Finance (Grace): confirm whether Acme’s expected PO (target May 20) counts as a commit we can use to hold slots; if not, outline fallback billing (burst + short-term reservation pricing).
3) Infra (Vivek/Karthik): tentatively hold 12 A100-equivalent slots for Acme for week of July 11 (pending Grace). Provide ETA on whether we can convert ephemeral H100 usage to A100 reservations if needed.
4) Customer (Sara): please share any additional traffic patterns (sample logs or trace) — helps us decide on quantization vs. pure capacity.

I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the action items and will drop the updated template into the Drive folder. Next check-in Thursday 10:00 PT.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pipeline-forecasts

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.com)
